name: trydesk-android
description: TryDesk for Android — control a Windows PC from your phone (viewer). Wraps the desktop renderer with Capacitor.

scripts.apk:debug: node build-www.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: node build-www.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
